text:
olivia: Quick sync on rollout metadata followup. I've been thinking about a compact on-path token but with verifiable off-path docs. idea: a small digest (sha1-like, 20 chars) in headers that references a control-plane doc. add a short proof field so clients can assert they fetched the correct doc. thoughts?

sam: digest+proof sounds good. keeps headers tiny and makes cache validation straightforward. prefer base62-encoded 16-20 char id. runtime only needs digest + cohort id. heavy stuff off-path.

maria: from observability: if we use opaque digests, control plane MUST emit the mapping digest->human_ref in events immediately when a rollout changes. also add `schema_ver` and `doc_source` fields in the control-plane event. otherwise tracing back is painful.

dinesh: runtime constraint: no big JSONs on hot path. SDKs should resolve digest->doc asynchronously and store compact runtime view: {fallbacks[], policy_flags, deprecation_ts}. synchronous miss should trigger a deterministic fallback list.

kevin: ops question: how do soft pins / tenant overrides play with the digest approach? we need per-tenant anchors that can override a digest without changing the global mapping. propose anchor objects that map tenant->digest and include expiry + audit id. runtime checks anchors first.

olivia: agree. call these `tenant_anchors`. anchor precedence: tenant_anchors > rollout_digest > default_digest. anchor lifecycle must include who created it and why. also require expiration.

anjali: SDK UX: surface anchor info via SDK.getEffectivePin(tenant) and an event hook SDK.onAnchorApplied so application owners know their traffic is pinned. also allow admin flag `ignore_anchors` for special deployments.

sam: technical: we should include a tiny monotonic version number in the digest token (nibble) so caches can detect simple revs without full refetch. and when control plane rotates a doc, it must mint a new digest to prevent stale cache surprises.

maria: telemetry: emit both `on_path_digest` and `resolved_ref` in spans. if anchor applied, emit `anchor_id` and `anchor_creator`. add a `schema_mismatch` event when runtime reads a doc with an unsupported schema_ver.

dinesh: runtime probe idea: add `/internal/pin-status?tenant=...` returning token, resolved_ref, effective_fallbacks (short list), anchor_id (if any). small JSON, rate-limited, for on-call. helps debugging without full control-plane access.

kevin: runbook: when replacing a digest, ops should perform a canary with delta telemetry: misparse rate, model-error increase, and client-schema-failures. include an automatic rollback hook if misparse% > threshold or spike in error-rate. we should encode `safety_policy` in control-plane docs: rollback_on_error, error_rate_threshold, min_requests. runtime reads only the small safety subset.

olivia: sketch control-plane doc (human readable):
```
{
  "doc_id": "cmp-2026-04-20-01",
  "digest": "D4f9a2b7XkZ",
  "schema_ver": "2026-04-1",
  "fallbacks": ["model-v3.2","model-v3.1"],
  "deprecation_ts": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
  "safety_policy": {"rollback_on_error": true, "error_rate_threshold": 0.02, "min_canary_requests": 100}
}
```

sam: prefer `min_canary_requests` to be per-cohort. also ensure docs are gzipped in storage and a proto cached blob for runtime.

maria: add audit event when control plane issues a new digest mapping with `issued_by` and `reason`. wire this into alerting so product/pm is notified on major changes.

dinesh: implementation note: runtime will store a small pre-parsed cache keyed by digest with LRU and a small pinned set for tenants with anchors. TTL + background refresh. avoid sync fetch paths.

anjali: clients need an opt-in `strict_mode` which fails fast on token->doc mismatch vs a `permissive_mode` that uses fallback. useful for QA vs prod.

compat-bot: :robot: Canary started for digest D4f9a2b7XkZ (cohort: canary). routing 10% to canary.

olivia: next steps: (1) sam to prototype digest encoder + tiny TLV layout, (2) dinesh to spec probe endpoints and cache eviction behavior, (3) maria to write telemetry mapping and audit events, (4) kevin to add runbook entries for digest rotation and automatic rollback. i'll draft the control-plane schema PR tomorrow.

sam: will try encoder this afternoon.

maria: adding telemetry items to backlog.

dinesh: will spec probe and pinned-cache rules.

kevin: i'll coordinate canary dashboards and rollback hooks with SRE.

olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
